task.title: Deleting a team within an organization by using the API
task.shortdesc: To delete a team from an organization in Red Hat Quay, you can use the organization team API endpoint with an OAuth access token.

ul.li: You have created an OAuth access token.

step.cmd: You can delete a team within an organization by entering the DELETE /api/v1/organization/{orgname}/team/{teamname} command:

info.p: This command does not return output in the CLI.
